events.factual_description: Blue Note New York presents Darryl Jenifer & The Dub Explorers on Monday, February 8, 2027, with 8:00 PM and 10:30 PM sets; doors are at 6:00 PM and 10:00 PM respectively. The club bills John Medeski, Ben Perowsky, Karma Chogyi Marco and special guests with Jenifer. Org Music documents Jenifer, Medeski, Perowsky and Marco as the core lineup of Jenifer's July 2026 instrumental album The Weather Channel, with Jenifer on bass and melodica, Medeski on keys, Perowsky on drums and percussion and Marco on guitar. The album combines new compositions with reinterpretations of two Bad Brains songs. Blue Note exposes separate authorized TicketWeb destinations for the two sets; the stored ticket link is for the 8:00 PM performance. No ticket face value is stated in the accessible official page text; the listed $20 amount is a per-person food and beverage minimum, not a ticket price.

en.why_it_matters: The exact Weather Channel quartet is the point: Jenifer's bass and melodica carry the Bad Brains/DC mixture of punk force, reggae space and fusion curiosity into a band with Medeski's keys, Perowsky's elastic drums and Marco's guitar. This is not a nostalgia booking; the project turns that lineage into a current instrumental language built from dub weight, psychedelic texture and open improvisation.
en.trip_verdict: Make room for it during a New York stay, especially if the bridge from DC hardcore to dub and improvised jazz is the draw. The active album project and choice of two sets make a dedicated trip optional.

es.why_it_matters: El punto es el cuarteto exacto de The Weather Channel: el bajo y la melódica de Jenifer llevan la mezcla de fuerza punk, espacio reggae y curiosidad fusionera de Bad Brains/DC hacia una banda con los teclados de Medeski, la batería elástica de Perowsky y la guitarra de Marco. No es una fecha de nostalgia; el proyecto convierte ese linaje en un lenguaje instrumental actual hecho de peso dub, textura psicodélica e improvisación abierta.
es.trip_verdict: Vale hacerle espacio durante una estancia en Nueva York, sobre todo si atrae el puente entre el hardcore de DC, el dub y el jazz improvisado. El proyecto discográfico activo y la opción de dos sets hacen opcional un viaje dedicado.

events.subtitle: Different Strokes for Different Folks
events.factual_description: Blue Note New York presents Charlie Hunter and Ella Feingold on Monday and Tuesday, March 1-2, 2027, with 8:00 PM and 10:30 PM sets on both nights; doors are at 6:00 PM and 10:00 PM respectively. The venue frames the engagement around their 2025 duo album Different Strokes for Different Folks, an improvisational guitar conversation drawing on funk, minimalism, jazz, soul and ambient texture. Blue Note describes Hunter's approach as combining bass lines, chords and melody on custom extended-range guitars and identifies Feingold's inverted tuning as the basis for voicings unavailable in standard tuning. The venue exposes separate authorized TicketWeb destinations for all four sets; the stored ticket link is for the first performance. No ticket face value is stated in the accessible official page text; the listed $20 amount is a per-person food and beverage minimum, not a ticket price.

Stage 1 rests on the concrete contrast between Hunter's simultaneous bass/chord/melody method and Feingold's inverted tuning inside a recorded improvisational duo. Stage 2 assigns A+ because the interaction is actively worth prioritizing, while four sets across two nights and an ongoing album project make S-level scarcity unsupported.

en.why_it_matters: This is a guitar duo built around two different ways of reorganizing the instrument. Hunter folds bass line, harmony and melody into one part; Feingold's inverted tuning opens chord shapes and walking motion unavailable in standard tuning. Their album treats groove, silence and texture as equal partners, so the live interest is the real-time conversation rather than a conventional exchange of solos.
en.trip_verdict: Actively prioritize one of the four sets if New York is already in play. The two-night run offers enough flexibility to choose a set without rebuilding a wider itinerary.

es.why_it_matters: Es un dúo de guitarras construido alrededor de dos maneras distintas de reorganizar el instrumento. Hunter concentra línea de bajo, armonía y melodía en una sola parte; la afinación invertida de Feingold abre acordes y movimiento caminante que no existen en la afinación estándar. Su disco trata el groove, el silencio y la textura como socios iguales, así que el interés en vivo está en la conversación en tiempo real y no en un intercambio convencional de solos.
es.trip_verdict: Conviene priorizar activamente uno de los cuatro sets si Nueva York ya está en juego. Las dos noches ofrecen suficiente flexibilidad para elegir un set sin reconstruir un itinerario más amplio.
